E2E E-18 stop-mid-turn cancellation fixture.

Follow these steps exactly:
1. First, emit assistant text containing exactly one line: [E2E:E18:OK]
2. Immediately after that line, use your normal shell/terminal command tool to run:
   python3 -c "import time; time.sleep(60)"
3. Do not write, echo, quote, or mention [E2E:E18:LATE] before the command returns.
4. Only if the turn is still running after the command returns, send exactly: [E2E:E18:LATE]

The harness will cancel this turn while the command is sleeping. If cancellation arrives, stop without sending the late marker.
